name: Every operator and verifier list change is audited
summary: operators/verifiers add|remove take --actor OPERATOR and --reason TEXT; restore-new too for re-grants. A change appends one entry to authority-changes.audit.json (0600, 200 kept), under the lock, before the configuration. Every NEW history begins with a baseline of the lists as they stood; an unreadable list is null (UNKNOWN), never empty. An ADD that would start a history while a list cannot be read is refused; a REMOVAL never is, for the audit or the OTHER list: it records null and goes on. authority-changes prints the trail and the replay: replay.agrees is false when ANY comparable list disagrees, beside an unreadable or null (UNKNOWN) one, and null (incomplete) when none does and one was not compared, or no trail. authority-changes-baseline (operator, --actor/--reason) keeps the replaced history as .replaced-* and writes a FRESH history of the lists as they stand, refusing an unreadable list. A damaged audit never refuses a REMOVAL: the bytes are kept beside it first. The placeholders are refused on an ADD (re-checked under the lock) and dropped on a REMOVAL, recorded unattributed. NOT covered: a hand edit of deployment.private.json; a list change by an older kit.
